decision.rule: ACCEPT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX.
decision.reason: Every attack was refuted. The subject sits at the expected digest and mode 0444 and was re-hashed unchanged at the end of the review. All frozen predecessors named in the dispatch are unmoved at their pinned digests, and git reports zero modifications to tracked files, so file 08, COORD and every predecessor are unedited. All 43 recordedInputs entries recompute correctly against the working tree, and recordedInputs.HEAD equals both the top-level head and live HEAD. The dispatched MUST-FIX is landed exactly: basedOn.d304.role now reads as last-heading custody only, the two leftover-join lineage sentences present at v10 are gone, and the only DR-103 token left in the file is the failsIf guard for that very defect. A leaf-level diff of v10 against v11 shows no key added or removed except the predecessorV10 block and its three recordedInputs and three roster entries, and no substantive text change beyond the d304.role repair, the leftoverJoinV7.role 'on that join' scoping, the currency-roster extension to v10, and version relabelling. The live G01 harness cell and all six other derived verbatim fields compare byte-equal against the row located by the '| DR-G01 ' line prefix. requiredNowUnchanged 28 matches file 08's live condition-4 text '28 of 28 required gates name a recorded identifier'; Condition 2 at 5 of 32 matches the live condition-2 cell. Every cross-artifact claim about distribution-core leftover-join.v9 was checked in that artifact's own bytes: summary.leftoverDesign is exactly [OBL-2, OBL-D1, OBL-D2], d006UnitUndecided is true, harnessSpecificationsNotAuthored is false. D-293 Decision 7 item C9 in COORD carries the cited unit rule, and the three cited commits resolve to D-293, D-287 and D-304. D-304 is the last COORD heading, D-231 recorded G01 occupancy v9, and no COORD entry records v10 or v11, so the frozen/unrecorded/not-current standing is accurate. The subject writes the D-293 rule and the D-006 numeral only: 25000000 is absent, and all four 26214400 tokens sit inside explicit non-authorization clauses carried unchanged from the dual-ACCEPT v9 bytes. Zero current-speaker deictic tokens remain; every v11 token carries the 'G01 occupancy' qualifier, so none collides with the version integer 11.
